title: lupinus wyethii var. prunophilus
intro: Lupinus wyethii var. prunophilus, commonly known as Wyeth's lupine, is a plant species within the genus Lupinus, native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Wyeth's lupine include its use as a natural expectorant and diuretic, helping to relieve respiratory issues and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Wyeth's lupine include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
